claim.claim-text: 1. A tool (500) for locating an insertion point of a radial component of a wrist prosthesis on a human distal radius bone, the tool (500) comprising:
2. A tool (500) according to claim 1, wherein the opening (508) is a circle.

3. A tool (500) according to claim 1, wherein the opening (508) is arranged at a top portion of the handle, optionally wherein the opening (508) is arranged interposed between the top portion of the handle and the third visual cue (506).
4. A tool (500) according to any one of the preceding claims, wherein parallel notches are provided along the handle.
